Full copied hash-leaf history/Tree means no whole-history memory bound. Empty HMAC key yields successful HmacUnchecked; no checkpoints can succeed without public key/independent anchor. verify_with_witness adds supplied signatures only after base success, empty checkpoint list still zero witnessed scope. Native Scope successful prefixes omitted from compatibility JSON. Private incremental and scan remain cfg(test); one authored source test not new execution or release qualification.

Resource/signing I/O errors return Result rather than mismatch/success. Caller owns node policy, witness layer and trusted source/root; these helpers do not establish EOF/native identity or operational authorization. No new executed tests.
